description: How a failed catalog access probe is classified from the driver's error. The classification decides which error a user sees and whether the failure is cached: an authorization failure is stable and is remembered per relation, a transient one is retried on the next touch, and an unknown one is neither. Drivers differ in what they raise, so each case gives only the two things every driver carries, a SQLSTATE (empty when the driver reported none) and a message.

cases.name: snowflake access control message
cases.message: SQL access control error: Insufficient privileges to operate on table 'SALES'

cases.name: databricks permission message
cases.message: PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have SELECT on Table 'main.default.sales'

cases.name: a network policy refusal is authorization, not a network fault
cases.message: Incoming request with IP 10.0.0.1 is not allowed to access Snowflake

cases.name: syntax error with a sqlstate
cases.message: syntax error at or near SELCT
